title: verbena litoralis f. albiflora
intro: Verbena litoralis f. albiflora, commonly known as Beach Verbena or White Beach Verbena, is a flowering plant species native to the coastal regions of the Americas. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reduced stress and anxiety due to its sedative and calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Verbena litoralis f. albiflora include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it a useful remedy for soothing digestive issues and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
